card.name: Words just before approximately in dosing
card.fires_on: Small verbs and linking words (by, to, with, is, add) right before an expected 'approximately' or amount in dose adjustment and preparation instructions.

modes.label: Dose change by a percent
modes.description: The word 'by' after increase or decrease dose, before approximately and a percentage.
modes.example: Hb is less than 9 g/dL (Hb <9.0 g/dL) Increase dose<< by>> approximately 50% to the closest

modes.label: Volume or concentration in preparation
modes.description: A linking word before an approximate volume or concentration when mixing or diluting.
modes.example: immediately transfer contents of the reconstituted vial to 50 mL of 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection. The resultant concentration<< is>> approximately 20 mg/mL. Complete

modes.label: Timing after a dose
modes.description: The unit or word before approximately and an hour interval.
modes.example: followed by one tablet of doravirine (PIFELTRO) 100<< mg>> approximately 12 hours after the dose

card.writes: It favors words meaning 'according to' or 'based on' and suppresses 'around' and 'about', so it steers away from those words for approximation.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before an approximate amount in dosing or mixing instructions.
